capture_source: loopback run 2026-11-08: built-in SNC initiator against SAP CommonCryptoLib (gss_accept_sec_context / gss_unwrap / gss_wrap / gss_verify_mic / gss_get_mic) as the acceptor, both on one host, lab test PSEs CN=LOOPCLI / CN=LOOPSRV. No SAP system involved.
evidence: tier 3 behavioural: the reference GSS implementation accepted every client token and record and produced the reply records stored here. The replay test re-derives every client record byte for byte and decrypts/verifies every reply record.
notes: records[]: kind 'wrap': client wraps plain_hex, the acceptor unwraps it and wraps 'echo:' + plaintext as reply. kind 'mic': client sends plaintext + get_mic token, the acceptor verifies it and replies with get_mic over 'mic:' + plaintext.
Plaintexts cover the padding edges (15/16/17 bytes) and the 16384-byte chunk boundary (16384 = one chunk, 16385 = two chunks), both directions.
